title: Added Linux ARM wheels
description:
scikit-misc is currently missing Linux ARM wheels. It's configured to be able to build them, but the Github workflow to actually execute that is missing.

To actually publish an ARM wheel, once this PR is merged:

1. Go to the Actions tab → Build Wheels workflow
2. Click Run workflow
3. In the branch/ref dropdown, select the v0.5.2 tag
4. Run it — this builds and publishes just the new aarch64 wheel via --skip-existing, leaving the rest of the v0.5.2 release untouched

title: Numpy 1.x backwards-compatibility fix
description:
Before Numpy 2.0, `numpy.asarray()` does not support a `copy` keyword.

Partially reverts (one line of) cd9026f90bd9e523fa9343d36968f0c0e4a7980f.

Fixes #35.

title: Use calloc instead of malloc for safe_malloc
Update index.rst
description: There is no word following "at" in the current page.

title: check openblas64 pkg-config when looking for the openblas module
description:
openblas v0.3.22 renamed openblas.pc to openblas64.pc. https://github.com/OpenMathLib/OpenBLAS/pull/3791

when building scikit-misc with openblas v0.3.24 the build [breaks](https://hydra.nixos.org/build/241192431) as it can not find the module.

this change adds `openblas64` to the list of openblas module names in the dependency call.

title: Use stderr for output from subprocess
description:
contextlib.redirect_stdout does not support stdout of subprocesses

This is used by Fedora packaging RPM macros extensively.
Having subprovesses print to stdout, would otherwise require
manual patching of the script in the build process.
